The line joining the centres is perpendicular to and bisects the common chord, so each half of PQ is 4 cm. The centres lie on opposite sides of PQ, so their distances to the chord add to give AB.

For circle A, the distance from A to PQ is \(\sqrt{7^2-4^2}=\sqrt{33}\) cm.

For circle B, the distance from B to PQ is \(\sqrt{10^2-4^2}=\sqrt{84}=2\sqrt{21}\) cm.

Therefore, \(AB=\sqrt{33}+2\sqrt{21}\approx 14.9\) cm.
